_doc: The engine half of the conventions (PROP-003 sec. 3): the intervention types, the categories, the layer order and the marker forms are the same for every project type. The subsystems an intervention id may name, the service ids own code may never re-register, the build outputs a fresh pass may remove and the paths a patch may never target are the project type's answer and live in its package; a patch set extends the family's lists additively through conventionsExtensionFile.

markerComment._doc: Marker forms by file extension (PROP-004 section 1). Every key except this one is a file extension, or the whole name of a file that begins with a dot and has no extension (PROP-004 MR-FORM-KEY); the value is {open, close}: the marker line is <indent><open>begin <ID><close> and <indent><open>end <ID><close>. For line-comment languages close is the empty string. Keys starting with an underscore are documentation and are never matched against an extension.
